objective: Harden the strict external AGI claim path so the user-facing CLI cannot lower the two-independent-group quorum.
actions: Reviewed the strict external claim CLI after PR 146 request binding was merged.
Identified that --min-independent-groups-per-criterion accepted values below the repository strict default.
Changed the CLI to fail closed before evidence loading when the requested quorum is below two groups per criterion.
Added regression coverage and merged only after exact-head CI completed successfully.
observations: The lower-level library still supports explicit non-default development policies for tests and research, but the production CLI no longer permits a weakened evaluator quorum.
No new external production evidence was created by this change.
claims: The strict claim CLI now rejects a quorum below two independent external evaluator groups per criterion before reading evidence.
This hardens the claim boundary but does not establish AGI.
